senses.exPt: Obrigado pelo convite para a sua festa.

senses.def: to ask someone to come to a party, meal or event
senses.ex: She invited me to her birthday party.
senses.exPt: Ela me convidou para a festa de aniversário dela.

senses.def: without wanting or planning to
senses.ex: He smiled involuntarily when he heard her name.
senses.exPt: Ele sorriu sem querer quando ouviu o nome dela.

senses.def: to include something as a necessary part
senses.ex: The job involves a lot of travelling.
senses.exPt: O trabalho envolve muitas viagens.

senses.def: taking part in something
senses.ex: How many people were involved in the project?
senses.exPt: Quantas pessoas estavam envolvidas no projeto?

senses.def: a strong, hard grey metal
senses.ex: The old gate is made of iron.
senses.exPt: O portão antigo é feito de ferro.

senses.def: to make clothes smooth with a hot iron
senses.ex: I need to iron my shirt for tomorrow.
senses.exPt: Preciso passar minha camisa para amanhã.

senses.def: an electrical object you heat to make clothes smooth
senses.ex: Be careful, the iron is still hot.
senses.exPt: Cuidado, o ferro de passar ainda está quente.

senses.def: the job of making clothes smooth with an iron
senses.ex: I hate doing the ironing on Sunday evenings.
senses.exPt: Odeio passar roupa no domingo à noite.

senses.def: not following the usual pattern or rule; not happening at regular times
senses.ex: Many common English verbs are irregular.
senses.exPt: Muitos verbos comuns em inglês são irregulares.

senses.def: to make someone annoyed, or to make skin sore
senses.ex: His loud music really irritates me.
senses.exPt: A música alta dele me irrita muito.

senses.def: used with he, she and it to say who or what someone is
senses.ex: My father is a doctor in a big hospital.
senses.exPt: Meu pai é médico num hospital grande.

senses.def: used with he, she and it to describe a state or place
senses.ex: The weather is very nice today.
senses.exPt: O tempo está muito bom hoje.

senses.def: a piece of land with water all around it
senses.ex: We spent our holiday on a small Greek island.
senses.exPt: Passamos as férias numa pequena ilha grega.

senses.def: an island, often used in names
senses.ex: They spent their holiday on a small Greek isle.
senses.exPt: Eles passaram as férias numa pequena ilha grega.

senses.def: the state of being alone or separated from other people
senses.ex: Many old people suffer from isolation and loneliness.
senses.exPt: Muitos idosos sofrem com o isolamento e a solidão.

senses.def: an important subject people talk about
senses.ex: Climate change is a very important issue.
senses.exPt: A mudança climática é uma questão muito importante.

senses.def: a problem or difficulty
senses.ex: We had some issues with the internet this morning.
senses.exPt: Tivemos alguns problemas com a internet hoje de manhã.

senses.def: one copy of a magazine or newspaper printed at a certain time
senses.ex: Have you read the latest issue of the magazine?
senses.exPt: Você leu a última edição da revista?

senses.def: used for a thing or animal already mentioned
senses.ex: I bought a new car. It is red.
senses.exPt: Comprei um carro novo. Ele é vermelho.

senses.def: used for an action, idea or situation
senses.ex: Can you do it today?
senses.exPt: Você pode fazer isso hoje?

senses.def: one thing in a list or a group of things
senses.ex: There are ten items on my shopping list.
senses.exPt: Há dez itens na minha lista de compras.

senses.def: belonging to a thing or animal already mentioned
senses.ex: The dog is playing with its ball.
senses.exPt: O cachorro está brincando com a bola dele.

senses.def: used when a thing or animal does something to itself
senses.ex: The cat is cleaning itself on the sofa.
senses.exPt: O gato está se limpando no sofá.

senses.def: used to talk about the thing only and not things around it
senses.ex: The town itself is small, but the beaches are beautiful.
senses.exPt: A cidade em si é pequena, mas as praias são lindas.

senses.def: by itself: without help or without anyone doing it
senses.ex: The door opened by itself.
senses.exPt: A porta abriu sozinha.

senses.def: the hard white material that elephants' tusks are made of
senses.ex: It is illegal to sell ivory in many countries.
senses.exPt: Vender marfim é ilegal em muitos países.
